headline: A native detection-head fine-tune lifted held-out macro F1 from 43.89% to 46.92% and eye recall from 18.18% to 27.27%, while eye precision fell from 80.00% to 66.67%. The 95% group-bootstrap interval for the macro-F1 gain touches zero, so this is an experiment candidate, not a validated improvement.
verified_boundaries: Offline detection metrics on 384 x 256 frozen inputs; not camera autofocus accuracy.
Labels are Z8-assisted human corrections, not independent blind annotation.
No camera deployment, no in-camera verification, no timing measured on camera hardware.
Weights are not redistributed: they embed vendor-derived numeric parameters.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU, 12 GiB

data.exclusion_reason: 158 deduplicate-hidden queue images and 1 image held for adjudication
data.split_policy: Frozen before training; groups never cross splits; test opened once after validation-only selection.
data.grouping_limit: 58 of the 80 test images share one conservative group, so the test set is not 80 independent scenes.
data.annotation_limit: Z8-assisted human review bound to the frozen 384 x 256 input; not blind ground truth, not original-image visibility.

method.trainable: original 8,784 head parameters; update masks restrict which rows may move
method.selected_update_scope: fine anchor 0 coordinates, objectness and known part rows; eye rows of other anchors; all auxiliary rows frozen
method.backward: explicit STE approximation for FP16 storage and integer dot/add; not the true derivative of the integer graph
method.forward_parity: all 535 cached images replayed bit-identical to the frozen FP16 output before training
method.postprocessor: original consumer with unchanged thresholds and tables
method.selection: maximise validation macro F1 at IoU 0.5 and eye distance 4 px, with per-part recall drop <= 0.05 and F1 drop <= 0.03
method.amendment: the F1 guard was added on validation before trial 4 and before the test set was opened

trials.method: positive-class competition at existing candidate positions

criteria.precision_scope: part-labelled images and explicit no-bird frames only; unlabelled parts are not negatives

compute.note: Local wall-clock on the machine above; excludes engineering, cache rebuilds, full-network reload and desktop load.

batch_throughput.scope: local CUDA native emulator, 16-image batch, warm-up plus three interleaved rounds; not single-image latency or camera FPS

second_round.kind: continued refinement from the trial_005 checkpoint
second_round.result: no new checkpoint beat the parent under the precision guard; selected_epoch -1 keeps the parent weights
second_round.isolated: The 80-image test set was closed for this round; every number is validation.

local_only: per-epoch logs, float master, target audits, executed code snapshots
industrial annotation database and dedupe records

next_steps: Reduce eye false positives at unmatched locations: the five validation misses sit 8.1-11.2 px from the labelled eye and inside the background guard radius.
Collect more independently reviewed eye negatives; only four restorable deleted eye false positives exist today.
Grow the number of independent conservative groups before claiming held-out gains.
Keep phase detection, lens drive and the full AF loop out of any accuracy claim.
